statements.query: MATCH (l:GCPLabel)<-[:LABELED]-(n:GCPBigqueryTable)<-[:HAS_TABLE]-(:GCPBigqueryDataset)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:GCPProject{id: $GCP_PROJECT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:GCPOrganization{id:$GCP_ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE n.lastupdated <> $UPDATE_TAG WITH l LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DETACH DELETE (l) return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted
statements.__comment__: Delete the labels of GCP Bigquery Tables the next statement deletes (label ids embed the table id, so they are the table's own).

statements.query: MATCH (n:GCPBigqueryTable)<-[:HAS_TABLE]-(:GCPBigqueryDataset)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:GCPProject{id: $GCP_PROJECT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:GCPOrganization{id:$GCP_ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE n.lastupdated <> $UPDATE_TAG WITH n LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DETACH DELETE (n) return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted
statements.__comment__: Delete GCP Bigquery Table that no longer exist and detach them from all previously connected nodes.

statements.query: MATCH (:GCPBigqueryTable)<-[r:HAS_TABLE]-(:GCPBigqueryDataset)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:GCPProject{id: $GCP_PROJECT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:GCPOrganization{id:$GCP_ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE r.lastupdated <> $UPDATE_TAG WITH r LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DELETE (r) return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted
statements.__comment__: Remove GCP GCPBigqueryTable-to-GCPBigqueryDataset relationships that are out of date.

statements.query: MATCH (n:GCPAcl)-[:APPLIES_TO]->(o:GCPBigqueryDataset)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:GCPProject{id: $GCP_PROJECT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:GCPOrganization{id:$GCP_ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE n.lastupdated <> $UPDATE_TAG AND coalesce(o.iam_policy_status, '') <> 'unresolved' WITH n LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DETACH DELETE (n) return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted
statements.__comment__: Delete GCP Access that no longer exist and detach them from all previously connected nodes. A GCPBigqueryDataset whose grants could not be read this sync (iam_policy_status unresolved) keeps its last-read ones.
